name: desktop
description: Cloud Quran desktop app (Electron). Shell is Epic 6; story 5-5 landed the OAuth return path.
_comment_no_electron: There is deliberately NO `electron` dependency yet. The shell is Epic 6, and adding electron is an ask-first dependency story 5-5 does not have. `src/authCallback.ts` therefore takes every Electron API it needs as an injected interface, so the OAuth return path — the part with logic worth getting right — compiles, is unit-tested and is ready to wire, with nothing installed. `scripts/build-desktop.mjs` (inherited from wisdom-fruits) expects src/main.ts and src/preload.ts; both arrive with the shell.
_comment_engines: `test` runs `node --test src/*.test.ts` — Node's own TYPE STRIPPING, which did not stabilise before 22.6 and is only unflagged from 23.6. The repo root already pins >=24 and every other package inherits that by convention; this one runs a .ts entry point DIRECTLY, so a mismatched Node here fails with a bare syntax error that names neither TypeScript nor the version.
_comment_devDependencies: `typecheck` runs `tsc`, which resolved only through the hoisted root store — invisible until someone installs this workspace alone, or the root drops the dependency. `nodeLinker: hoisted` means the declaration costs no extra install; it states what this package actually runs. `electron` is deliberately still absent: the shell is Epic 6 and adding it is ask-first, which is why `src/authCallback.ts` takes its Electron surface as an injected interface.
